mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said life, then he kept hearing amore, which his son tells him means love, and that love was being shed abroad over the land of Italy and Europe.
mentions.quote: Amore over Italy. Love was being shed abroad all over Italy
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised religious movement in Italy.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a marsh in South Korea whose water table rose until it overflowed into Japan, North Korea, Vietnam, the Philippines and China, and a modern day Pentecost and Azusa Street.
mentions.quote: the water table got higher and higher and then it started to overflow
mentions.falsify_match: A revival originating in South Korea spreading across east Asia.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord called it a modern day Azusa Street out of South Korea and that the gospel spread through the Asian nations, then saw Taiwan and China's plan to take it, hearing iron curtain.
mentions.quote: A modern-day Azusa Street, the Lord said, out of South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: An Asian revival originating in South Korea, and a Chinese move on Taiwan.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as he saw people praying, South Korea, Japan, Australia and the Philippines rose up saying they would not allow it to take place yet, forming a front.
mentions.quote: We're not going to allow this to take place yet
mentions.falsify_match: A regional bloc forms to deter a move on Taiwan.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is upfront and bold, that he sees a decade window and asked what it was, that Taiwan will fall during the tribulation from what he saw, and that he could miss it because he is human.
mentions.quote: Could I miss it? Yeah, I'm human. I can miss it
mentions.falsify_match: Taiwan falls to China inside a ten year window.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He attaches an explicit possibility of error, which is rare here.

mentions.claim_text: He is reminded that he saw the sun rising over eastern Africa and then saw America, and asks whether he has covered everything.
mentions.quote: You saw the sun rising over Eastern Africa
mentions.falsify_match: A religious movement across east Africa.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be great deception in the days ahead concerning this, that he saw a flying object over the Mayan temples and over the Vatican, and a mothership like a ball of light.
mentions.quote: I saw a UFO, a flying object over the Mayan temples
mentions.falsify_match: A widely reported aerial phenomenon over those sites tied to a religious deception.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Putin and Ukraine, is told to come up higher, and says he does not know how to say what he is seeing, calling it demonic.
mentions.quote: Come up higher. It's a demonic and it's something to do with
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to a stated claim later.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; he says he cannot articulate it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the spirit of the Lord is going to visit Minnesota like a wave of the glory, that it will not be only Minnesota, and that they are about to have a visitation.
mentions.quote: Minnesota, you're about to have a visitation from the Lord
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised revival in Minnesota.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the fox again looking toward New Orleans, that it was the one smuggling evidence out of Cuba, and that they know they are about to be infiltrated by the secretary of state.
mentions.quote: He was the one that I told you was smuggling evidence out of Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: Material is confirmed moved out of Cuba ahead of American action.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. The fox is now identified as the smuggler, which is the first interpretation he has given it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the fox was leaking things to people the Lord called pirates at the Bay of Pigs, that he saw them retaliating in the days ahead, and that the Ukrainian president is a snake and a bad man whom people are blind to support.
mentions.quote: The Lord called them pirates in the Bay of Pigs
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuban retaliation and a public turn against Zelensky.

mentions.claim_text: He says they declared there is no more cat and mouse game, that he saw unconventional Russian weapons never seen before, and long range missiles given to Ukraine that would strike deep inside Russia including Moscow.
mentions.quote: There is no more cat and mouse game. We're done
mentions.falsify_match: Long range missiles supplied to Ukraine strike Moscow and Russia responds with a novel weapon.

mentions.claim_text: He says the French president is the puppet and the bankers are behind it, and that he saw Satan in an office manifesting through a satanic seance with bankers and politicians who took direct words from him.
mentions.quote: I saw Satan in an office talking with manifestation through a satanic seance
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim is a spiritual meeting.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says a bad signal came up out of a blood sacrifice containing a swastika, that everything requires blood, and that he saw the Cuban president cutting chickens and drinking blood in what he calls voodoo and dark magic.
mentions.quote: I saw Cuba president cutting chickens and drinking blood
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of ritual practice by the Cuban leadership.

mentions.claim_text: He says North Korea becomes friends with Russia and Asian and Chinese alliances rise to Russia's aid in the days ahead, while China turns its eyes toward Taiwan and will want to take it.
mentions.quote: North Korea will become friends with Russia
mentions.falsify_match: A formal Asian bloc supporting Russia and a Chinese move on Taiwan.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. North Korean support for Russia has been open since 2024, so the first half is already true.

mentions.claim_text: He says the glorious church will rise in South Korea, that God is giving them a window, and that a great river and a well of revival will spring forth out of South Korea with a wave of glory over all Asia.
mentions.quote: A great river and a well of revival will spring forth out of South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: A revival movement out of South Korea across Asia.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will go over the Philippines and China, that a great underground church beneath Asia will rise and proclaim Jesus with signs following, and that the greater the persecution the greater the revival.
mentions.quote: a great underground church that's been underneath Asia rise up
mentions.falsify_match: Open growth of the Chinese underground church.
mentions.falsify_miss: Continued suppression. The persecution clause makes either outcome fit.

mentions.claim_text: He says great things and a great shaking are coming to Cuba, and that he saw a war trying to come to Europe with unconventional weapons never seen before, and that they will strike Poland and Warsaw.
mentions.quote: they will strike Poland, Warsaw
mentions.falsify_match: A strike on Warsaw with a novel weapon.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for the president's safety because he must finish, and says the vice president will be polished and pushed forward strongly, starting to build his own platform and push away from the president especially by the midterms.
mentions.quote: He'll start getting his platform and he'll start pushing away
mentions.falsify_match: A visible public separation between Vance and Trump before the midterms.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is what he told them, that he saw the Ukrainian president going to Europe and that he did exactly what the Holy Spirit said.
mentions.quote: So he did just exactly what the Holy Spirit told us
mentions.falsify_match: The trip matches a specific advance detail.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. European tours are Zelensky's standing practice.

mentions.claim_text: He and his co-host work out that the trip included Belgium, and he says he does not know who one of the figures is.
mentions.quote: he had a lot of Belgium
mentions.falsify_match: Belgium features in the arrangement he describes.

mentions.claim_text: He says he had told them the Ukrainian president turns into a black widow spider with a shiny red marking and weaves a web across Europe, and asks the audience to confirm they remember it.
mentions.quote: he turns into a black widow spider and his butt is shiny with red
mentions.falsify_match: Zelensky assembles a European coalition that then turns on its members.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such outcome. He asks the audience to vouch for the pre-commitment rather than replaying the recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the Asians and Turkey coming to aid and cutting off the aid, and turns to footage of what the missiles are doing to Moscow and to refineries.
mentions.quote: I saw him going and Turkey comes to aid and they cut off the aid
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey acts to cut Ukrainian resupply.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to say this again: when it happens he saw a draft coming to America because there were not enough troops and they were spread too thin, involving women as well as men.
mentions.quote: I saw a draft coming to America because there wasn't enough troops
mentions.falsify_match: American conscription reintroduced including women.

mentions.claim_text: He says he had named Canada, England, France, Germany and Italy as together, and that this came about through a satanic tie he saw with the king, who rose up and became a scorpion.
mentions.quote: the king rise up and he became a scorpion
mentions.falsify_match: Those five states act together with the British monarch prominent.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip saying Israel's biggest problem is not the American president and that anyone in Israel who thinks so should wake up, then asks his co-host whether he remembers what he said was coming out of this.
mentions.quote: Israel is not Donald J. Trump
mentions.falsify_match: An open Israel and America rupture.

mentions.claim_text: He plays an official saying they do not want desperate Cuban refugees flooding into the country, that they want Cubans to be happy and successful, and that they are talking to the Cuban government about how it could change.
mentions.quote: We're actually talking to the Cuban government right now
mentions.falsify_match: American and Cuban negotiations produce a change of government.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the Israeli prime minister saying the population of southern Lebanon cannot return and they must continue to control the territory even if the American president disagrees because they are an independent state, and says this is what the Lord told him would be said.
mentions.quote: We must continue to control the territory even if Trump disagrees
mentions.falsify_match: Israel holds southern Lebanon against American objection.

mentions.claim_text: He sees loose ends being tied like a bow to finish the thing with Iran, but says Israel is a wild hair and that Netanyahu wants what is in the mountain and will not stop until he gets it.
mentions.quote: We cannot stop until we get what's in the mountain
mentions.falsify_match: Israel acts unilaterally against a specific Iranian mountain facility after a settlement.

mentions.claim_text: He plays an announcement of six hundred billion dollars to design and build chips in America, a rise in value of over half a trillion in nine months, and an American stake now over sixty billion, saying this is what the Lord said.
mentions.quote: $600 billion. Nine months and they'll increase in value
mentions.falsify_match: American chip manufacturing investment at that scale materialises.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The figures come from the announcement he is playing, not from a prior word.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the Chinese leader saying Taiwan is an inalienable part of China's territory and that its future can only be decided by over 1.4 billion Chinese people including Taiwan compatriots.
mentions.quote: The future of Taiwan can only be decided by the Chinese people
mentions.falsify_match: China moves on Taiwan.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. This is the standing Chinese position restated, not a new escalation.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the defence secretary describing NATO 3.0 as a return to a hardline military alliance with real capabilities to deter on the continent and lead Europe's conventional defence.
mentions.quote: NATO 3.0 is postcold war recognition that it needs to go back
mentions.falsify_match: NATO restructures with Europe taking conventional lead.

mentions.claim_text: He breaks off to thank his wife for water, then returns saying look at this and asks what he had told them was going to happen.
mentions.quote: What did I tell you was going to happen?
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a transition.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; the item is not described in the passage.

mentions.claim_text: He gives thanks that nothing happened on the fourteenth, that all twenty three of the people who had planned evil works are now in custody and will not hurt civilians of the nation.
mentions.quote: all 23 of them are now in custody
mentions.falsify_match: Twenty three people are confirmed in custody over a plot tied to that date.
mentions.falsify_miss: The number or the date does not match the public record.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats four times that God has not forgotten the people of Europe, quoting him saying I see you, I am the most high, come unto me.
mentions.quote: He has not forgotten the people of Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A religious movement across Europe.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the Philippines and says it will not happen yet concerning Taiwan, that God will not allow it yet, that they have their plans but he has his, and that he sees prayer holding it.
mentions.quote: They have their plans, but I have mine
mentions.falsify_match: China does not move on Taiwan in this period.
mentions.falsify_miss: China moves. As put, a non-event confirms the holding back and an event confirms the plans.

mentions.claim_text: He tells the church to pray, says God will hold it back and that he sees a dome of protection, names South Korea and Japan coming to the aid, and says he sees a time frame.
mentions.quote: I will hold it back. I see a dome of protection
mentions.falsify_match: Regional deterrence prevents a Chinese move.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a ten year window concerning Taiwan and China going into the tribulation, that it has to be the tribulation, and that the Lord told him not so much detail because it is not necessary.
mentions.quote: I see a 10year window concerning Taiwan in China
mentions.falsify_match: Taiwan falls inside ten years.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said it is not time yet for Taiwan, that he is giving a reprieve and holding back the communist curtain, and that it will not come on their land yet.
mentions.quote: He's holding back the communist curtain
mentions.falsify_match: Taiwan remains free through the period.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a wave of the glory hitting Taiwan and South Korea, with a pool of water springing forth as a fountain of living water.
mentions.quote: I see a wave of the glory hitting Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: Religious movements in both.

mentions.claim_text: He says a great pool of water will spring forth out of Taiwan with great life given, then corrects himself to say a well of revival will begin in South Korea and go into Taiwan.
mentions.quote: a well of revival will begin in South Korea that will go into Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: A revival originating in South Korea reaching Taiwan.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. He corrects the origin mid-sentence.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a drought with the water receding, then a brand new well like a geyser coming about five feet out of the earth and filling the pool with living water like a fountain that never runs dry.
mentions.quote: a brand new well that is a geyser that comes out about 5 foot
mentions.falsify_match: A religious movement follows a period of decline.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will be the modern day Azusa Street of Asia, that God will put hot spots throughout China, and that there will be wells of revival not quenched by the communist curtain.
mentions.quote: I'll put hot spots throughout China
mentions.falsify_match: Open church growth inside China despite state restriction.

mentions.claim_text: He laughs and says he is getting drunk in the spirit, and that a fresh new river will come over them.
mentions.quote: I'm getting drunk in the spirit
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a description of his own state.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says the communist curtain will not come and a time and a reprieve are given, that Asians and even Australia will come to Taiwan's aid, and asks what is going on in America because he sees a storm.
mentions.quote: I even see Australia coming to the aid concerning Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: Australia commits to Taiwan's defence while America is preoccupied.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the American flag standing in the middle of the land with a storm all around it and four white doves circling the flag.
mentions.quote: I see the four doves circling our flag
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; no interpretation is offered.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a shaking of the land, a shaking in Toronto and in the churches of Toronto, because great persecution will come.
mentions.quote: I see a shaking in the churches of Toronto
mentions.falsify_match: State or legal action against Toronto churches.

mentions.claim_text: He says a press is coming with pure olive oil on the lips of the preachers so they will speak the good news, with a honey glow on their lips and new wine.
mentions.quote: pure olive oil will come upon the lips of the preachers
mentions.falsify_match: A preaching movement in Canada following restriction.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a great shaking with darkness on the land toward the east of America and light coming on the church, gives that as the time frame, and says the flag remains.
mentions.quote: I see darkness upon the land toward the east of America
mentions.falsify_match: A crisis centred on the eastern United States alongside church growth.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord does not give the whole puzzle but one piece at a time, and that he was told there were things about the fourteenth and that the fourteenth was highlighted.
mentions.quote: There's things about the 14th. The 14th was highlighted
mentions.falsify_match: A recording dated before 14 June shows the date being named.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such recording. The passage asserts the pre-commitment without replaying it.

mentions.claim_text: He says a New York disturbance was not really a big distraction and just people being stupid, and that he kept praying when he saw the president going to the G7 summit and around the French president, with prayer running into tomorrow when he comes home.
mentions.quote: I saw him around Emanuel Macron and what the Lord has told me to pray
mentions.falsify_match: An incident at the summit or on the return.

mentions.claim_text: He says the French president is a mole and a weasel and the Ukrainian president is a Pinocchio and a puppet, and that a lot of the billions given in aid went to slush funds.
mentions.quote: Emanuel Macron is a weasel and Zelensky is a Pinocchio
mentions.falsify_match: Misappropriation of Ukraine aid is documented.

mentions.claim_text: He says substations at power plants will be attacked causing outages of up to three weeks or more in major cities including Philadelphia and New York and smaller towns, with disruption to emergency services, and points to a California water system hit by Iranian hackers.
mentions.quote: causing major power outages for up to three weeks plus in major cities
mentions.falsify_match: A multi week outage in a major American city from a substation attack.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such outage. The California water incident he cites is a hack, not an outage.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls the Israeli prime minister at the United Nations and delegates walking out, notes the SIM cards found in New York to overload the emergency system almost a year earlier, and says the Lord told him it is not just there.
mentions.quote: the Lord said, It is not just here
mentions.falsify_match: Similar SIM card installations found in other American cities.

mentions.claim_text: He says the money system in Europe is in trouble and that he saw bankers, naming one as George, talking directly to Lucifer and having meetings with the devil, who appeared before them in the visions.
mentions.quote: George was one of them was talking directly to Lucifer
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim is a spiritual meeting.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put. The euro half is checkable, the seance half is not.
